record.bible_text: Then the LORD<WH03068> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Job<WH0347> out of the whirlwind<WH05591>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,
Who <FI>is<Fi> this that darkeneth<WH02821><WTH8688> counsel<WH06098> by words<WH04405> without knowledge<WH01847>?
Gird up<WH0247><WTH8798> now thy loins<WH02504> like a man<WH01397>; for I will demand<WH07592><WTH8799> of thee, and answer<WH03045><WTH8685> thou me. <RF>answer...: Heb. make me know<Rf><CM>

Where<WH0375> wast thou when I laid the foundations<WH03245><WTH8800> of the earth<WH0776>? declare<WH05046><WTH8685>, if thou hast<WH03045><WTH8804> understanding<WH0998>. <RF>hast...: Heb. knowest understanding<Rf>
Who hath laid<WH07760><WTH8804> the measures<WH04461> thereof, if thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8799>? or who hath stretched<WH05186><WTH8804> the line<WH06957> upon it?

Whereupon are the foundations<WH0134> thereof fastened<WH02883><WTH8717>? or who laid<WH03384><WTH8804> the corner<WH06438> stone<WH068> thereof; <RF>foundations: Heb. sockets<Rf> <RF>fastened: Heb. made to sink?<Rf>
When the morning<WH01242> stars<WH03556> sang<WH07442><WTH8800> together<WH03162>, and all the sons<WH01121> of God<WH0430> shouted<WH07321><WTH8686> for joy?
Or <FI>who<Fi> shut up<WH05526><WTH8686> the sea<WH03220> with doors<WH01817>, when it brake forth<WH01518><WTH8800>, <FI>as if<Fi> it had issued out<WH03318><WTH8799> of the womb<WH07358>?
When I made<WH07760><WTH8800> the cloud<WH06051> the garment<WH03830> thereof, and thick darkness<WH06205> a swaddlingband<WH02854> for it,
And brake up<WH07665><WTH8799> for it my decreed<WH02706> <FI>place<Fi> , and set<WH07760><WTH8799> bars<WH01280> and doors<WH01817>, <RF>brake...: or, established my decree upon it<Rf>

And said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Hitherto<WH05704><WH06311> shalt thou come<WH0935><WTH8799>, but no further<WH03254><WTH8686>: and here shall thy proud<WH01347> waves<WH01530> be stayed<WH07896><WTH8799>? <RF>thy...: Heb. the pride of thy waves<Rf><CM>
Hast thou commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> the morning<WH01242> since thy days<WH03117>; <FI>and<Fi> caused the dayspring<WH07837> to know<WH03045><WTH8765> his place<WH04725>;
That it might take hold<WH0270><WTH8800> of the ends<WH03671> of the earth<WH0776>, that the wicked<WH07563> might be shaken out<WH05287><WTH8735> of it? <RF>ends: Heb. wings<Rf>
It is turned<WH02015><WTH8691> as clay<WH02563> <FI>to<Fi> the seal<WH02368>; and they stand<WH03320><WTH8691> as a garment<WH03830>.
And from the wicked<WH07563> their light<WH0216> is withholden<WH04513><WTH8735>, and the high<WH07311><WTH8802> arm<WH02220> shall be broken<WH07665><WTH8735>.
Hast thou entered<WH0935><WTH8804> into the springs<WH05033> of the sea<WH03220>? or hast thou walked<WH01980><WTH8694> in the search<WH02714> of the depth<WH08415>?
Have the gates<WH08179> of death<WH04194> been opened<WH01540><WTH8738> unto thee? or hast thou seen<WH07200><WTH8799> the doors<WH08179> of the shadow of death<WH06757>?
Hast thou perceived<WH0995><WTH8712> the breadth<WH07338> of the earth<WH0776>? declare<WH05046><WTH8685> if thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> it all.
Where <FI>is<Fi> the way<WH01870> <FI>where<Fi> light<WH0216> dwelleth<WH07931><WTH8799>? and <FI>as for<Fi> darkness<WH02822>, where <FI>is<Fi> the place<WH04725> thereof,

That thou shouldest take<WH03947><WTH8799> it to the bound<WH01366> thereof, and that thou shouldest know<WH0995><WTH8799> the paths<WH05410> <FI>to<Fi> the house<WH01004> thereof? <RF>to the bound: or, at, etc<Rf>
Knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> thou <FI>it<Fi> , because thou wast then born<WH03205><WTH8735>? or <FI>because<Fi> the number<WH04557> of thy days<WH03117> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07227>?
Hast thou entered<WH0935><WTH8804> into the treasures<WH0214> of the snow<WH07950>? or hast thou seen<WH07200><WTH8799> the treasures<WH0214> of the hail<WH01259>,
Which I have reserved<WH02820><WTH8804> against the time<WH06256> of trouble<WH06862>, against the day<WH03117> of battle<WH07128> and war<WH04421>?
By what<WH0335> way<WH01870> is the light<WH0216> parted<WH02505><WTH8735>, <FI>which<Fi> scattereth<WH06327><WTH8686> the east wind<WH06921> upon the earth<WH0776>?<CM>
Who hath divided<WH06385><WTH8765> a watercourse<WH08585> for the overflowing of waters<WH07858>, or a way<WH01870> for the lightning<WH02385> of thunder<WH06963>;
To cause it to rain<WH04305><WTH8687> on the earth<WH0776>, <FI>where<Fi> no man<WH0376> <FI>is; on<Fi> the wilderness<WH04057>, wherein <FI>there is<Fi> no man<WH0120>;
To satisfy<WH07646><WTH8687> the desolate<WH07722> and waste<WH04875> <FI>ground<Fi> ; and to cause the bud<WH04161> of the tender herb<WH01877> to spring forth<WH06779><WTH8687>?
Hath<WH03426> the rain<WH04306> a father<WH01>? or who hath begotten<WH03205><WTH8689> the drops<WH096> of dew<WH02919>?
Out of whose womb<WH0990> came<WH03318><WTH8804> the ice<WH07140>? and the hoary frost<WH03713> of heaven<WH08064>, who hath gendered<WH03205><WTH8804> it?
The waters<WH04325> are hid<WH02244><WTH8691> as <FI>with<Fi> a stone<WH068>, and the face<WH06440> of the deep<WH08415> is frozen<WH03920><WTH8691>. <RF>is...: Heb. is taken<Rf>

Canst thou bind<WH07194><WTH8762> the sweet influences<WH04575> of Pleiades<WH03598>, or loose<WH06605><WTH8762> the bands<WH04189> of Orion<WH03685>? <RF>Pleiades: or, the seven stars: Heb. Cimah<Rf> <RF>Orion: Heb. Cesil?<Rf>

Canst thou bring forth<WH03318><WTH8686> Mazzaroth<WH04216> in his season<WH06256>? or canst thou guide<WH05148><WTH8686> Arcturus<WH05906> with his sons<WH01121>? <RF>Mazzaroth: or, the twelve signs<Rf> <RF>guide: Heb. guide them<Rf>
Knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> thou the ordinances<WH02708> of heaven<WH08064>? canst thou set<WH07760><WTH8799> the dominion<WH04896> thereof in the earth<WH0776>?
Canst thou lift up<WH07311><WTH8686> thy voice<WH06963> to the clouds<WH05645>, that abundance<WH08229> of waters<WH04325> may cover<WH03680><WTH8762> thee?
Canst thou send<WH07971><WTH8762> lightnings<WH01300>, that they may go<WH03212><WTH8799>, and say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee, Here we <FI>are<Fi> ? <RF>Here...: Heb. Behold us?<Rf>
Who hath put<WH07896><WTH8804> wisdom<WH02451> in the inward parts<WH02910>? or who hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> understanding<WH0998> to the heart<WH07907>?
Who can number<WH05608><WTH8762> the clouds<WH07834> in wisdom<WH02451>? or who can stay<WH07901><WTH8686> the bottles<WH05035> of heaven<WH08064>, <RF>stay: Heb. cause to lie down<Rf>
When the dust<WH06083> groweth<WH03332><WTH8800> into hardness<WH04165>, and the clods<WH07263> cleave fast together<WH01692><WTH8792>? <RF>groweth...: or, is turned into mire: Heb. is poured<Rf>
Wilt thou hunt<WH06679><WTH8799> the prey<WH02964> for the lion<WH03833>? or fill<WH04390><WTH8762> the appetite<WH02416> of the young lions<WH03715>, <RF>the appetite: Heb. the life<Rf>
When they couch<WH07817><WTH8799> in <FI>their<Fi> dens<WH04585>, <FI>and<Fi> abide<WH03427><WTH8799> in the covert<WH05521> to<WH03926> lie in wait<WH0695>?

Who provideth<WH03559><WTH8686> for the raven<WH06158> his food<WH06718>? when his young ones<WH03206> cry<WH07768><WTH8762> unto God<WH0410>, they wander<WH08582><WTH8799> for lack<WH01097> of meat<WH0400>.<CM>
